case b

case a

end
end
in
let neg = 
fun n ->
 -1 * n

fun (a,b)  ->
 a+b

let minus = 
fun (a,b) ->
a - b

let times = 
fun (a,b) ->
 a * b
in



let evaluate : Expr -> Int = 
fun expr ->
case expr
|NumLit(n) => n
| UnOp(op, expr) => 
case op
| OpNeg => neg(evaluate(expr))
end
| BinOp(op, expr1, expr2) =>
case op
|OpPlus => plus(evaluate(expr1), evaluate(expr2))
| OpMinus => minus(evaluate(expr1), evaluate(expr2))
| OpTimes => times(evaluate(expr1), evaluate(expr2))
end
end
